ideas.title: The Rise of Antifa: Investigating Connections to Violent Protests
ideas.description: This story would investigate the activities and potential connections of Antifa to violent protests, exploring the group's ideology and tactics.
ideas.angle: Exploring the connection between Antifa and violent protests
questions: What are Antifa's goals and tactics?
How are they connected to violent protests?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover patterns and connections between Antifa and violent protests, shedding light on the group's activities and potential threats.

ideas.title: UFC Event Security: What Went Wrong?
ideas.description: This story would investigate the security measures in place for the UFC event at the White House and what went wrong.
questions: What security measures were in place?
How did the plot to attack the event unfold?
ideas.insight: This story could reveal potential vulnerabilities in event security and the need for increased vigilance.
